text:
Maya: Quick sync: aiming to run a joint demo with LangChain + LlamaIndex + VertexEdge HW partner next Tue. Goal: marketplace listing + hands-on demo for SIs.
Liam: Nice. What's the scope of the demo? end-to-end pipeline w/ gateway, orchestration, and hardware-attached quantized model?
Sophia: Yes — gateway adapter -> orchestrator recipe -> deploy on partner GPU (low-precision) -> show embedding+search and streaming generative step.
Raman: Tech asks: container image size, model repo, quantization artifacts, and a preload KV cache for the demo to make it snappy.
Claire: Marketing: we need a one-liner, short bullets for marketplace, 30s demo script, and partner-approved screenshots.
Maya: Timeline proposal: Thurs for infra prep, Fri for adapter bake, Mon for partner smoke, Tue demo. Can eng-infra reserve test node Mon-Tue?
eng-infra: reserving test-node-eu-2 for Mon-Tue. Please file infra-request-456 and include exact image tag.
Liam: I'll prepare an adapter shim that accepts gateway tokens and translates to /v1/run calls. Suggest API key pilot; OAuth GA.
Raman: I'll add support for 4-bit quantized weights and an env flag QUANT_MODE=4bit. Example launch: `docker run -e QUANT_MODE=4bit redwood/adapter:demo`.
Sophia: Also add a perf script and small prompt corpus (50 queries) to show p50/p95 and token cost. Keep it reproducible.
Claire: Partner legal: need co-marketing agreement boilterplate. @Maya can you start legal thread? we'll need logo approvals by Friday.
Integrations Bot: created ticket PA-789: demo coordination + co-marketing. Assigned to Maya, Liam, Raman.
Maya: Thanks. Liam/Raman, can you commit the adapter README and quickstart by Thursday EOD? I'll loop partners and SIs.
Liam: Yep. PR target Thursday. Will include sample Helm chart and a single-command quickstart.
Raman: Adding a small fallback policy: if quantized model OOM, fall back to server-hosted float32 variant and log a metric.
Sophia: Great — for the marketplace entry we'll include supported model list, hardware tested, and recipe link. Claire will draft copy.
Maya: Perfect. I'll post a final checklist tomorrow. :rocket:
